form.label: Notable Slack Enrichment
form.description: Structured data collected by notable_to_slack_json.py for a specific Adaptive Response invocation. Reached via the custom drilldown_uri on that action's entry in a notable's Adaptive Responses panel (form.sid / form.rid are passed automatically).

panel.title: Slack delivery / enrichment record for this notable

search.query: | inputlookup notable_slack_enrichment_lookup where sid="$sid$" AND rid="$rid$" | table event_id sent_at delivery_method slack_channel slack_permalink status error additional_fields | sort - sent_at

panel.title: Agentic AI verdict (Phase 2/3 - bin/slack_hec_bridge.py)
panel.description: awaiting_ai_response=1 means the bridge is still polling the Slack thread for a reply. hec_sent=1 / notable_enriched_at populated means the verdict was written to index=risk and back to this notable as a comment.

search.query: | inputlookup notable_slack_enrichment_lookup where sid="$sid$" AND rid="$rid$" | table slack_thread_ts awaiting_ai_response risk_object risk_object_type risk_score risk_message hec_sent notable_enriched_at | sort - notable_enriched_at
| inputlookup notable_slack_enrichment_lookup where sid="$sid$" AND rid="$rid$" | sort - sent_at | head 1 | table additional_fields | fields - _key
